facts.fact: Standard Bank Group (South Africa), through Stanbic Africa Holdings, signed a subscription agreement on 9 October 2026 to buy shares in OPay, the Nigeria-focused fintech, for up to US$200 million, subject to OPay's US listing going ahead and regulatory approval; Nigeria produced 89.5% of OPay's revenue in H1 2026 and the amount is not split by country.
SoftBank Vision Fund 2 (Japan) led a US$400 million round in OPay in 2021, which valued the Nigeria-focused fintech at US$2 billion, as Reuters reported at the time per this document.

note: Two deals with amounts; the OPay payments product itself is not a system in the study's field.
